Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray shows multiple large, well-circumscribed "cannonball" metastases, and the history of an enlarged testicle in a 64-year-old man is highly suggestive of a paratesticular low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma, which is known to metastasize to the lungs with this specific radiographic appearance. While renal cell carcinoma also causes cannonball metastases, the explicit mention of the testicular mass points to the sarcoma diagnosis provided in the options.
